title: Criterion (catalog entry or call-specific requirement)
description: A test the eligibility_judge evaluates for one (profile, target entity) pair. 'hard' = rule: not_met excludes. 'soft' = preference: only orders. Catalog criteria come from criteria_catalog.grant.v1.json; call-specific ones (REQ-xx) are created from verified evidence spans with binding=true.

evaluator.description: 'code' criteria are computed deterministically (dates); any LLM output for them is ignored.

applicability.description: 'always': not_applicable is forbidden (forced to unknown). 'conditional': not_applicable allowed with a rationale; WITHOUT an evidence id it is only allowed when the opportunity has >=1 official source document with page_type=call (rule R4b).

profile_fields.description: Profile paths needed to decide. If any is null in the profile, met and not_met are forced to unknown (rule R3).

requirement_text.description: Required when origin=extracted: the extractor's one-line summary of the binding requirement.
